# route_paths names the hub's types: output_paths_type, output_route_builder_type
# and output_route_type name the three types the hub declares, and the two
# suffix members name each package's types after its namespace. A constructor is
# New and the type's name.

muxt generate
exists route_paths.go
muxt check
exec go build ./...
exec go test ./site

-- go.mod --
module example.com/m

go 1.22
-- muxt.json --
{
	"route_paths": {
		"output_paths_type": "Paths",
		"output_route_builder_type": "Routes",
		"output_route_type": "Route",
		"output_package_paths_type_suffix": "Paths",
		"output_package_route_builder_type_suffix": "Routes"
	},
	"package_defaults": {
		"use_receiver_type": "Server"
	},
	"packages": {
		"example.com/m/admin": [{}],
		"example.com/m/blog": [{}]
	}
}
-- admin/admin.go --
package admin

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) Dashboard() []int { return []int{42} }
-- admin/dashboard.gohtml --
{{define "GET /admin Dashboard()"}}{{range .Result}}<a id="self" href="{{$.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a><a id="path" href="{{$.Path.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a><a id="route" href="{{$.Route.Blog.GetArticle .}}">article</a>{{end}}{{end}}
-- blog/blog.go --
package blog

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateSource embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateSource, "*.gohtml"))

type Server struct{}

func (Server) GetArticle(id int) string { return "article" }
-- blog/article.gohtml --
{{define "GET /article/{id} GetArticle(id)"}}<h1>{{.Result}}</h1><a href="{{.Path.Admin.Dashboard}}">admin</a>{{end}}
-- site/site_test.go --
package site

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"example.com/m"
	"example.com/m/admin"
	"example.com/m/blog"
)

func TestNamedTypes(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	var paths m.Paths = admin.TemplateRoutes(mux, admin.Server{})
	blog.TemplateRoutes(mux, blog.Server{})
	var blogPaths m.BlogPaths = paths.Blog()
	if got, want := blogPaths.GetArticle(7), "/article/7"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("blogPaths.GetArticle(7) = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	var routes m.Routes = m.NewRoutes("")
	var blogRoutes m.BlogRoutes = routes.Blog()
	var route m.Route = blogRoutes.GetArticle(42)
	if got, want := route.Path(), "/article/42"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("route.Path() = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
	if got, want := m.NewPaths("/x").Blog().GetArticle(1), "/x/article/1"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("m.NewPaths(%q).Blog().GetArticle(1) = %q, want %q", "/x", got, want)
	}

	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	mux.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/admin", nil))
	if got := rec.Result().StatusCode; got != http.StatusOK {
		t.Errorf("GET /admin status = %d, want %d", got, http.StatusOK)
	}
	if body := rec.Body.String(); !strings.Contains(body, "/article/42") {
		t.Errorf("GET /admin body = %q, want it to contain /article/42", body)
	}
}
